name: 33160 · Aventura, FL
findings: ZIP 33160 (Aventura) has 131 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33160 (Aventura) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33160 (Aventura) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 18% of the typical level).
